query: An internet-facing JetBrains TeamCity build server was exploited using CVE-2023-42793, followed by credential access and persistent access.
A modular malware framework is detected on a WatchGuard small-office router, with persistent activity involving network devices.
A spearphishing attachment targets foreign-policy analysts at a think tank and seeks intelligence about Korean peninsula policy.
A Citrix NetScaler ADC or Gateway exposed to CVE-2023-4966 shows session hijacking followed by ransomware deployment.
